text:
zoe (People Ops): quick 'rapid goal' checklist + peer feedback primer. meant for teams who want a lightweight, repeatable artifact to paste into PRs, 1:1s, and reviews.

zoe (People Ops): TL;DR: make tiny, timebound bets (48-72h), collect 2 evidence items, and add a 1-line peer ask.

zoe (People Ops): ```Rapid Goal micro-commit (pasteable)
Objective (one line): <outcome you can prove in 2-3 days>
Micro-bet (48-72h): <what you'll ship or validate> (owner + due date)
Success signals (pick 2): <metric change / experiment result / demo link>
Evidence binder (2 items): <link1>, <link2>
Peer ask (one sentence): <what you need from a reviewer or teammate>
Next check (date/time or async note)
```

mark (eng-manager): love the 48-72h framing. helps break big KRs into verifiable steps.

anya (product): suggestion: add a one-line "user value" sentence after Objective so PMs can quickly validate it.

zoe (People Ops): added: `User value: <one line>` in the snippet.

raj (ic): for peer feedback, can we map PR comments to KRs? makes reviews count toward reviews.

zoe (People Ops): yep. here's a 3-line peer primer for PRs and review threads: 

```Peer PR primer (3 lines)
1) Signal I saw: <one concrete effect or test you ran>
2) Suggestion: <small change or question to speed delivery>
3) Impact note: <how this helps the KR / user>
```

claire (hr): flag for managers: encourage contributors to upload the Evidence binder links into the review packet before calibration. keeps packet light and factual.

mark (eng-manager): will pilot this for my team's sprint reviews. would be neat if the repo template includes the micro-commit card as a PR template section.

snippet-bot: :white_check_mark: Saved Rapid Goal + Peer PR primer to People Ops snippets and added a handbook quick-copy.

zoe (People Ops): final tip: when writing evidence, prefer one-line context + a link (e.g., "reduced median latency from 230ms -> 110ms (dashboard)"). short + verifiable beats long essays.

raj (ic): great guidance. copying into my PR template now.

mark (eng-manager): thanks — will report back after the sprint demo. :rocket:
